verdict.rationale: Appwrite documents its own deletion capabilities: a storage API to delete files, CLI management of rows, files and users, and bucket-level stripping of location, device and capture-time metadata from uploaded images. Nothing in the evidence shows configurable retention controls such as TTLs, auto-expiry, log or backup retention windows, or account-erasure workflows. Missing for 10: configurable retention policies, automatic expiry/purge of data, documented user/account erasure and backup retention controls, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion

citations.quote: It provides APIs to upload, download, delete, and list files, with many added utilities.
Storage buckets can now remove location, device, and capture time metadata from uploaded images.
